services.name: Stem Program
services.desc: The Pacific Fleet Submarine Museum offers our visitors opportunities to further their understanding of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) through its STEM Engagement Program which includes field trips, interactive exhibits, demos, and activities that enhance the total visitors’ museum

services.name: Admission
services.desc: In this reel, our museum curator shares the story behind the design and why a well-known baseball figure from the 1930s became the symbol for a WWII submarine crew. This artifact is part of our behind-the-scenes collection and is not currently on display. Fill out the form below and we'll be in touch to discuss availability and details. The cost is $1,000, which is a tax-deductible donation to our education

services.name: School Tours
services.desc: Dive into the history of submarines! Climb aboard the historic World War II submarine USS Bowfin, nicknamed “The Pearl Harbor Avenger,” to see how confining and demanding the life of the undersea warrior was. Self-guided tours of USS Bowfin await you and your students. EDUCATION
